notes: «وثبتني معمر عن عروة» is a corroboration (mutabaʿa) naming another transmitter, so it is a variant group, never a route; the Companions are therefore only in the variant
the main route as written ends at Zuhri: no name after him is written in the main clause
«حفظت بعضه» is Sufyan's remark and is left out
